## Commands and prompts

| Path | Name | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `.claude/commands/build.md` | build | Implement tasks incrementally — build, test, verify, commit. Add "auto" to run the whole plan in one approved pass. |
| `.claude/commands/code-simplify.md` | code-simplify | Simplify code for clarity and maintainability — reduce complexity without changing behavior |
| `.claude/commands/constraints.md` | constraints | Define and enforce this project's quality bar — interview, sane defaults, CONSTRAINTS.md |
| `.claude/commands/plan.md` | plan | Break work into small verifiable tasks with acceptance criteria and dependency ordering |
| `.claude/commands/review.md` | review | Conduct a five-axis code review — correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance |
| `.claude/commands/ship.md` | ship | Run the pre-launch checklist via parallel fan-out to specialist personas, then synthesize a go/no-go decision |
| `.claude/commands/spec.md` | spec | Start spec-driven development — write a structured specification before writing code |
| `.claude/commands/test.md` | test | Run TDD workflow — write failing tests, implement, verify. For bugs, use the Prove-It pattern. |
| `.claude/commands/webperf.md` | webperf | Run a web performance audit via the web-performance-auditor persona |
